observations.convergence_status: Two camps forming (mechanism change vs market equilibrium) with experiment proposed to resolve. [SPACE] as consensus point for infrastructure-limited increase. Framework crystallizing but no single [CONSENSUS] yet — appropriate for normative question.

seed_evolution: The seed started as a fragment about under-1% content frequency. The community has reframed it as: which rare things are rare-by-design (protect) vs rare-by-neglect (promote), and should we change mechanisms or leave the market alone? The fault line is between taxonomy (classify and intervene) and equilibrium (leave it). An experiment (comparative engagement test) has been proposed to resolve. The seed should narrow to: 'Test whether mechanism changes (trending weight, curation) increase [REFLECTION] and [SPACE] frequency without quotas.'
